## Purpose

Accept a verified gateway envelope into the global supervisor inbox. This command
is internal to the Discord intake path; no HTTP route accepts it.

## When a playbook uses it

Playbook and agent principals cannot use intake. Only `service("discord-gateway")`
with `source: gateway|backfill`, or a local operator with explicit
`provenance: test|replay`, may submit an envelope.

## How it works internally

[`conversation_commands.py`](../../../src/commands/conversation_commands.py)
checks the observed author, configured guild/channel, allowlist, preconditions and
limits. The database atomically records the conversation, input and supervisor
message, deduplicating by transport and external message id. The contract redacts
the entire envelope because its text is nested inside it.

## Side effects and persistence

New inputs persist before thread-open delivery is enqueued. Replays reuse the
original input and do not spend additional rate quota. The deduplicated outbox
can repair a crash between persistence and enqueue.

## Failure modes and diagnostics

Refusals include `out_of_scope`, `spoofed_identity`, `invalid_envelope`,
`preconditions_unmet`, `author_not_allowlisted`, `foreign_destination`, `empty_text`,
`oversize`, `rate_limited`, `conversation_closed` and `conversation_not_found`.
`aq supervisor-inbox status` reports readiness and intake diagnostics.

## Example step

A gateway router dispatches the observed envelope under its service principal and
passes `source: gateway`. It uses the returned `created` flag to distinguish first
acceptance from a replay; it never derives sender identity from user-provided fields.
